title: Easter
status: draft: written 19 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 2 Christian Religious Education; not yet checked by a CRE teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child says Jesus' death was a sign of God's love, that he rose on the third day, and lists Easter church activities.

floor.prerequisite: Knows the church is a place of worship.
floor.question: What do people do in church?

steps: Say what happened on the third day.

board.do: Write: died, buried, raised on the third day.
Wait for the child to say Jesus rose from the dead.

misconceptions.ask: Why did Jesus die on the cross?
What happened on the third day?
Name an activity done in church at Easter.
misconceptions.repair: List church activities and home activities separately.
Put Christmas and Easter cards side by side.

checks.question: Name an activity in church at Easter.
